README: Read by Tests/SpriteRenderContract.swift and Tests/ModelsContract.swift (0.5.316). edgeFrames: 1-based frames of the approved Miles Windu pack (V12.6, and from 0.5.325 V14 timing-v2, whose V13 strips keep the same list plus trio 25, the strike's spark burst at 5 px) that may come within 6 px of a cell edge because a droid, wreck, jump or saber arc enters or leaves off canvas (independent check motion-v12/reviews/v12-6-holes-and-cuts-check.json). smear: the one documented translucency that is not a uniform fade. preExisting: strips that exceeded a gate before 0.5.316, at their measured ceiling, so they cannot get worse; they are not approvals. 0.5.324: edgeFades document only the 22 px smoothstep entrance mask during each rotation handoff. No Jedi interior-opacity ceiling exemptions remain. 0.5.328 (Version 15): each DefaultPet session pose now points at its first cast's full 1x strip, so the casts are gated here for the first time. edgeFrames for trio and swarm are the flyers and wrecks within 6 px of the top or side, the same frames V14's casts had (measured, installation-v1-5/qa); working and duel have none. preExisting holds V15's measured hole ceilings: the duel, trio and swarm casts fade a heavy-droid wreck under Windu at one alpha per frame, as V14's casts did. The first V1.5 bake's done-saber crop and violet wreck tint are fixed in V15 (installation-v1-5/compare/CLAIMS.md).
